title: Pin to Dock Pins to a Hidden Dock

judgment.rationale: Merged PR #48723 filters hidden Dock instances, addressing the original target-selection scenario. A 2026-10-17 report adds a specific Add/Remove membership mismatch for a Cmd item, which may be distinct and remains unverified.
evidence: Original report says an item is not added to a visible dock when the Dock is hidden on the primary display.
PR #48723 merged 2026-06-19 and only lists available Dock instances in the pin dialog.
A 2026-10-17 commenter on dual monitors reports a Cmd item whose Add/Remove menu state does not match actual Dock contents and supplies a video.
A maintainer says nested command pinning depends on extension-provided command IDs.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce the 2026-10-17 Dock membership/status sequence on a current build and compare it with merged PR #48723.

fix_assessment.rationale: A repository-side change is plausible, but the causal hypothesis remains unverified.

proposed_fixes.title: Keep Dock membership and command status in sync
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Red hypothesis: the Add/Remove action shown for a command can diverge from persisted Dock membership after a failed or partial pin attempt; the current report may also involve an unsupported extension command.
verification: Follow the latest reporter’s sequence and verify the action label matches Dock contents after each step.
Repeat with a command known to expose a pinnable ID and an unsupported nested command.

confidence.rationale: The new report provides a concrete mismatch, but the merged fix and extension pinning contract introduce distinct paths not yet traced.

plan: Reproduce the latest Cmd-item sequence on a current build and confirm the item is eligible for pinning.
At each Add/Remove transition compare visible Dock entries with the stored command membership.
If a mismatch is confirmed, fix the state update at the pin/unpin boundary and add a regression test for failed pin attempts.
Retain the merged hidden-Dock filtering from #48723.

prerequisites: Use the extension item described in the 2026-10-17 report or another command with known pin support.
Keep the Dock and command palette available during the test.
steps: Attempt to add the item from Command Palette.
If not visible, repeat and check whether the menu remains Add or changes to Remove.
Open Dock edit mode and remove the item if present.
Return to Command Palette and compare the menu label with actual Dock contents.
reproduce.expected_result: Add/Remove always reflects whether the item is actually present in the Dock.
